name: Hospicio Cabañas, Guadalajara
description: The Hospicio Cabañas in Guadalajara, Mexico, is a sprawling early 19th-century complex that once sheltered orphans, elderly people and the chronically ill. Its low, simple buildings are arranged around open courtyards, making it one of the largest institutions of its kind in the Americas. Today a museum, its chapel is covered in powerful murals by José Clemente Orozco, among Mexico's greatest artworks.
